Reg. 42 of 1964 An Act to provide for the determination of questions
as to the validity of elections to the office of
Speaker of the National Assembly or as to the
vacation of that office.
[29TH DECEMBER, 1964]
Short title. 1. This Act may be cited as the National Assembly
(Speaker’s Election and Vacation of Office) Act.

Delivery of 4.(1) A reference to the Court under this Act

(2) The reference shall be in the prescribed form,

(3) The Registrar shall send a copy of the reference
to the Clerk of the National Assembly, who shall cause it to be
laid before the Assembly.

Security for 5. (1) When a question has been referred to the Court

(2) Security shall be an amount of one thousand
dollars and shall be given in the prescribed manner by
recognisance entered into by any number of sureties approved
by the Court not exceeding four or by a deposit of money, or
partly in one way and partly in the other.

by virtue of any such provisions, the rules of court with respect
to costs in actions, causes and matters in the Court shall, so far
as practicable, apply in relation to the costs of proceedings

Notice of 4. The time and place of trial of a reference to which
hearing.

consultation with the Chief Justice and notice thereof shall be
given in writing by posting the notice at the Registry and by
sending a copy thereof to the person making the reference, to

General.
Procedure on 5. On the hearing of a reference the Court shall
reference. proceed as if such reference were a motion before the Court in
the exercise of its original jurisdiction and shall follow the
procedure of the Court on the hearing of a motion so far as the
same is applicable.
Fees of Court. 6. (1) No fees of Court shall be payable by or on behalf
of the Clerk of the National Assembly in respect of any
proceedings under these rules.
(2) Where the costs of any proceedings in relation to
which any provisions of the preceding paragraph apply, are
ordered to be paid by a party to the proceedings other than a
person exempted by that paragraph, such costs shall, unless
the Court otherwise orders, include the amount of any fees
which would have been payable by such a person in respect of
those proceedings but for the provisions of the preceding
paragraph.
